s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing eyelid mass with recent changes and crust formation
salient_findings: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the central lower eyelid
Flakier surface at one lateral end of the tumor
Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and neoplastic squamous cell proliferation
key_facts: 4-year history of a left lower eyelid mass
Recent growth and crust formation noted by the patient's wife
Tumor located on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
Specimen measured 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Microscopic findings include hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells involving hairs
Malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
Mitotic figures present
Central areas of clear cell change periodic acid-Schiff positive and diastase sensitive

raw.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing eyelid mass with recent changes and crust formation
salient_findings: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the central lower eyelid
Flakier surface at one lateral end of the tumor
Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and neoplastic squamous cell proliferation
key_facts: 4-year history of a left lower eyelid mass
Recent growth and crust formation noted by the patient's wife
Tumor located on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
Specimen measured 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Microscopic findings include hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells involving hairs
Malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
Mitotic figures present
Central areas of clear cell change periodic acid-Schiff positive and diastase sensitive

raw.rationale: The presence of a hyperkeratotic lesion, pseudohorn cysts, and proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells with malignant features such as eosinophilic cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, and mitotic figures strongly supports the diagnosis of skin cancer.

rejected.label: eyelid angiosarcoma
rejected.why: The microscopic findings do not indicate angiosarcoma characteristics such as vascular channel formation or endothelial cell proliferation.

rejected.label: chalazion
rejected.why: The presence of malignant squamous cells and mitotic figures is not consistent with a chalazion, which is a benign inflammatory lesion.

rejected.label: hordeolum
rejected.why: The clinical and histopathological features do not match a hordeolum, which is an acute or chronic inflammation of the eyelid margin, typically involving the meibomian or Zeis glands.

rejected.label: benign schwannoma of the eyelid
rejected.why: The malignant features observed in the histopathological examination, such as neoplastic squamous cells and mitotic figures, contradict the diagnosis of a benign schwannoma.
